note: Deeper than necro-only: per-style package trees, multi-mode, 729-path free+BiS, HP crossover, mode sensitivity

customizationNotes: Least region-dependent style: T95 weapons free.
Main customization is blessings + Aegis archetype, not weapon tree.

electiveBranches.why: T90 dual drygores / ZGS 2H — classic melee BiS branch
T90 2H scythe + tank kite for Aegis

customizationNotes: Highly customizable: free EZK 2H vs free khopeshes vs Desert drygores vs Mory scythe.
Shield (TMW/Malevolent kite) vs dual vs 2H completely changes Aegis %.
Berserk duty cycle dominates short windows — pathing more sensitive than necro.

electiveBranches.why: Best dual magic — Vorago; also cryptbloom free but seismic needs Asg

customizationNotes: Free FSOA 2H is excellent — dual seismic requires Asgarnia and is a real fork.
Cryptbloom tank set is free Misthalin (Croesus) — Aegis magic is viable locked.
Sunshine vs Higher Power timing differs from Berserk/Living Death.

electiveBranches.why: T90 dual — Legiones; also Stormguard/Ancient Inv

customizationNotes: Most branched weapon tree: free BOLG 2H vs SGB vs Asc dual vs Blight dual vs Eldritch.
Region package choice changes style identity more than necro.
Death's Swiftness duty cycle + caroming/ECB specs need deeper path×weapon matrix.

conclusion.necro: Least region-dependent — free Omni kit is complete; electives ~5%.
conclusion.melee: Most mode-sensitive — shield Aegis vs free EZK 2H vs Desert drygores; electives matter a lot.
conclusion.magic: Free FSOA 2H strong; Asgarnia seismic dual is the main fork.
conclusion.ranged: Most weapon-branch diversity (BOLG/SGB/Asc/Blight/ECB); package choice is identity.
